caption: The drawing depicts two representations of the same object, an old-fashioned ice skate. The primary depiction, located in the top left quadrant of the image, is a colored illustration showing a detailed side view. The skate has a long, rusted metal blade that curves upward into a hook at the front, with a wooden footplate secured on top. The blade is brownish-red with patches of rust, while the wood appears faded brown with traces of green discoloration. Attached to the top of the wooden plate are two metal fixtures with loops and a flat tightening mechanism, rendered in a metallic gray tone with visible shading to show texture. Below and to the right of this detailed illustration, there is a simple black line drawing of the same ice skate from a top-down perspective, showing the shape and placement of the components without color or texture. The background is a plain, slightly yellowed off-white, with some light staining and faint marks visible around the edges. The bottom left area contains a handwritten signature with the text “Lloyd Charles Lemke 1938.”
title: Ice Skate
